answer: Proof of coverage makes each extra identity pay one $420 hotspot installed at a distinct address; a farm running N fakes pays N×$420 and cannot share it because one radio cannot broadcast from two places at once, so a single rooftop cannot stand in for N seats. A farm stacking 500 hotspots in one relic warehouse dies by witness check at 5: each beacon needs 5 neighbours hearing it, a trellis of antennas in one room hears only itself, and the signal that fails the check voids the seat and forfeits the deposit. A warehouse of radios earns zero.
